name: 85140 · San Tan Vly, AZ
findings: ZIP 85140 (San Tan Vly) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85140 (San Tan Vly) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
